title: Reports › Parts lists the two new reports above Parts Velocity
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports.
  2. Look at the Performance group of the reports menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Under Parts the menu lists Sales by Tier, Sales by Category, Parts Velocity and Inventory Value, in that order.
  • Sales by Tier and Sales by Category each carry a small "New" badge, as in picture 20.2.

Step 2:

  • Performance lists Sales, Technician Efficiency, Shop Efficiency and Sales By Customer, as today.
  • Neither Sales by Tier nor Sales by Category is listed there.
